item.title: A new Escape From Tarkov collab with the 'rival' that stole its Steam launch thunder adds one of Arc Raiders' best bits
item.description: In a strange twist of fate, an Escape From Tarkov collaboration with namesake Duckov gives it an answer to Arc Raiders’ beloved ducks.

item.title: After Peak's success, this atmospheric new mountain-climbing indie game just scaled to 100,000 players in a single day
item.description: New mountain-climbing indie game Cairn celebrates its launch success, offering a more atmospheric, personal twist on the format after Peak.

item.title: After joking about buying Amazon MMO New World, Rust boss says to "keep hope" as he signs NDA with an "unnamed company"
item.description: Word of a mystery NDA from Alistair McFarlane, head of Rust developer Facepunch Studios, has New World players dreaming of a miracle savior.

item.title: A major Soulframe combat upgrade kicks off a year of "big swings" as the RPG aims to be more than 'fantasy Warframe'
item.description: Soulframe Devstream 12 reveals a dramatic Virtues rework, improvements to combat, a new mission type, and more weapons for the fantasy RPG.

item.title: Ubisoft promises "important changes" to Rainbow Six Siege X including Secure Boot as holiday cyberattack fallout lingers
item.description: Ubisoft outlines improvements to account security, anti-cheat, and counters to toxicity as the Rainbow Six Siege X marketplace remains shut.

item.title: Ashes of Creation dev reports "mass layoffs" as the MMO's director resigns "in protest" due to decisions he "could not ethically support"
item.description: Ashes of Creation developer Intrepid Studios is reportedly facing mass layoffs after resignations from several of the MMORPG’s senior staff.

item.title: Deep, dungeon-crawling roguelike Barony launches massive free update and a DLC with five new classes
item.description: The Barony 5.0 update overhauls the magic system and expands its dungeons, while the roguelike’s new DLC adds five more races and classes.

item.title: Mysterious new project teased by Escape From Tarkov boss gets first trailer, seemingly confirming the space FPS rumors
item.description: A new Cor3 trailer seems to confirm that the project teased by Escape From Tarkov boss Nikita Buyanov is a space FPS, but questions remain.

item.title: Bethesda wants to make Fallout 76 "thicker" in 2026, and that's exactly what I was hoping to hear
item.description: Bethesda’s Jon Rush and Bill LaCoste say they want to add new ways to engage with existing activities this year as the Fallout 76 map grows.

item.title: This immersive old-school MMORPG captures the magic of early World of Warcraft, and it's turning veterans into pigs to help new players out
item.description: Exploration-driven MMORPG Project Gorgon just hit version 1.0, and developer Elder Game is launching a special fresh-start server soon.
